provider: TGMCharts · SEC EDGAR statements and provider-computed ratios

asOf.note: lastClose is the verified official regular-session close; latestPrice is a regular-session quote and may be delayed. Fundamentals are trailing-twelve-month unless suffixed otherwise.

applicability.pegRatio: PEG needs a positive P/E, and this security's P/E is not available (diluted EPS or the price is missing, zero or negative).

statements.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL company facts (public domain)
statements.methodology: Values as filed with the SEC (XBRL company facts, public domain), selected latest-filed per period among the filings that carry the company's own financial statements (10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, 40-F, 8-K and 6-K reports, registration statements, and their amendments) — never a proxy statement's pay-versus-performance table; the winning us-gaap tag, accession number, and filing date are recorded per value in `provenance`. Quarters not filed discretely (Q4 generally; Q2-Q3 for cash-flow items, which 10-Qs tag year-to-date only) are derived solely by differencing two same-tag, same-fiscal-year facts and are marked derived with both source accessions; derivation is withheld when a surrounding filing restates prior periods. Per-share values are as filed and NOT adjusted for subsequent stock splits. Missing data is null — never zero-filled, never backfilled from any other source.
